coverage.prompt_handler: WebPlatformMacOS.mm lines 223-243: inactive/hidden/detached view immediately completes with nil; visible prompt keeps text field in the alert and block capture, registers the sheet for shutdown, removes it at completion, and returns entered text only for active confirmation. Inspected together with shutdown and destructor. No definite new lifetime fault established; no sheet interaction was executed.
coverage.policy_tests: TestWebPlatformPolicy.cc covers normalization, same-origin/default-port matching, off-origin and port changes, loopback HTTP, rejected credentials/control characters/non-web schemes, length and port boundaries, plus blob-download distinction. These are standalone assert-based tests; execution must retain assertions. Tests were read, not executed here.
coverage.native_tests: TestWebPlatformMacOS.mm requires a validation bundle identifier, prohibits activation, never orders its native window, checks coordinate conversion/visibility, visits eight routes, checks body content, recreates the native view and checks localStorage/cookie retention, rejects an off-origin navigation, and destroys a pending navigation. Optional third argument adds route/content checks. It does not test upload/download/prompt/confirm interaction, back-forward/reload, production auth/logout, display input/IME or cross-process persistence.
coverage.headless_probe: Final web_platform_dock.gd extends EditorPlugin and therefore uses the ordinary editor SceneTree. It checks headless mode, dock registration, invalid input, valid loopback setting, headless status, surface bounds across three sizes, hide/show and normal SceneTree quit. It writes EditorSettings, so its caller must provide the isolated settings/project environment. It cannot create a native view or prove visible layout/focus behavior.
coverage.formatting: The default clang-format exclusion exactly matches the added clang-format-web-platform selector. Both are anchored to direct editor/docks/WebPlatform* or tests/editor/TestWebPlatform* files ending cpp/h/cc/mm. Independently tested the selector against all changed source files and negative upstream/nested/GDScript examples. The override inherits the parent style and changes brace/short-function/short-lambda settings; ordinary upstream integration files keep the default hook. No formatting tool was run by this reviewer.
coverage.integration: Reviewed dock registration/class registration, macOS-only Objective-C++ source inclusion, editor-only WebKit framework linking, unchanged architecture deployment targets and ARC flag. Non-macOS factory still returns nullptr.
coverage.other_source_paths: Re-read origin policy, native ownership/destruction, modal completion cleanup, native clipping/visibility, status and retry logic. No additional definite product defect established within the authorized source scope. Navigation restriction does not constitute a subresource network sandbox.
